children: EnerSys appointed Navi Grewal as Chief Digital, AI and Information Officer to lead global digital, AI, IT, cybersecurity and data strategy.
Appointment effective October 16, 2026; Grewal will report to President and CEO Shawn O’Connell.
Grewal will join the Executive Leadership Team and lead digital, AI, IT, cybersecurity and enterprise data strategy.
Responsibilities include modernizing global business systems, advancing digital transformation and enterprise AI strategy.
Grewal brings nearly 30 years of technology and transformation experience, most recently as Global Chief Digital and Technology Officer at MasterBrand Cabinets.
